cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide mine to make me choose you?

mechanism: A revives its pupil old honest-answer exercise, offering progressively embarrassing admissions to elicit the motive behind hiding an invitation.
confusable: Not demanding repayment for vulnerability: each A disclosure is bait for the specific reason behind B choice.
comparison: Romantic jealousy revealed through mutual admissions versus professional shame during a walk.
seedUse: D136 invitation/Leah/birthday/photos; S05 coached naming the embarrassing reason.
